rec: California Baptist is a fast-rising program that has just joined the Pac-12. Under an 11th-season head coach it won the 2025 WAC regular-season title, two WAC tournaments (2022 and 2023) and its first NCAA Tournament match win, and it reached its first national ranking last year. The Exercise Science B.S. is a solid academic match with anatomy and physiology labs, biomechanics, exercise physiology and research methods, and it sits in Riverside, an inland Southern California city about an hour from Los Angeles and the beaches. The drawbacks are price (about $55,800 a year before scholarships), a stadium that seats just over 500, and a midfield of 7 in which 5 return for 2027.
